characters.name: Hanen (The Rooster)
characters.prompt: A proud Norwegian rooster from the 1400-1850 era, with a vibrant red comb, standing tall in a rustic forest clearing. He has bold plumage reflecting an old farmland setting and carries a determined look.

characters.name: Hønen (The Hen)
characters.prompt: A gentle Norwegian hen from the 1400-1850 era, with soft brownish feathers, appearing timid and delicate in a lush woodland undergrowth.

characters.name: Kilden (The Spring)
characters.prompt: A small forest spring with crystal-clear water, surrounded by mossy stones and dappled sunlight in an old Norwegian woodland scene from the 1400-1850 period.

characters.name: Linden (The Linden Tree)
characters.prompt: A tall, majestic linden tree in a 15th-century Norwegian forest, its broad leaves softly illuminated, evoking a serene, mystical presence.

characters.name: Jomfru Maria (The Virgin Mary)
characters.prompt: A serene figure in modest medieval Norwegian attire, radiating a gentle light, symbolizing compassion and grace in the 1400-1850 setting.

characters.name: Skomageren (The Shoemaker)
characters.prompt: An older Norwegian shoemaker from the 15th century, wearing simple work clothes, quietly crafting shoes in a humble workshop.

characters.name: Purken (The Sow)
characters.prompt: A stout sow in a rustic Norwegian farmyard circa 1400-1850, rummaging in straw near a small wooden fence.

characters.name: Træskemanden (The Woodcarver)
characters.prompt: A skilled Norwegian woodcarver from the 15th century, wearing a practical apron and intently carving wooden objects in a small hut.

characters.name: Bagstekonen (The Baking Woman)

characters.name: Vedhuggeren (The Woodcutter)
characters.prompt: A robust Norwegian woodcutter dressed in 1400-1850-era clothes, holding a worn axe in a dappled forest clearing.

characters.name: Smeden (The Blacksmith)

characters.name: Kulbrænderen (The Charcoal Burner)
characters.prompt: A soot-stained Norwegian charcoal burner in a simple shirt and trousers from the 15th century, tending a smoky charcoal pile deep in the forest.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An intricately detailed scene set in rural Norway between 1400 and 1850, showing the rooster rushing to bring water to the ailing hen in the lush Nøddeskogen. Depict each character—the Linden adorned with gold ribbons, Jomfru Maria in medieval Norwegian attire, the shoemaker at his bench, the sow rummaging in straw, and the charcoal burner with his smoking mound—surrounded by tall trees and dappled sunlight, capturing the folklore’s vibrant, rustic atmosphere.
modernMainImagePrompt: A modern Norwegian countryside setting with the rooster and hen near a small park fountain. The characters wear contemporary clothing and use modern tools: a shoemaker in a neat workshop, a woodcarver with power tools, and a charcoal burner using a metal kiln. Include a subtle Norwegian backdrop with cars passing by and a small village in the distance, reflecting today's society while preserving the folktale’s essence.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, cheerful illustration in a friendly cartoon style. The rooster and hen have soft, rounded features, big expressive eyes, and gentle smiles. Show each helper character—the cozy sewing shop for the shoemaker, a happy sow among colorful flowers, and a smiling charcoal burner in a tidy forest clearing. Use warm, soothing colors and a simple background to make it appealing for a 5-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: I et norsk skoglandskap med mykt sollys fra 1400-1850, ser vi Hanen som løper for å hente vann til Hønen. Rundt dem står Lindetreet med røde gullbånd og de andre hjelperne: skomakeren, treskjæreren, purka, og kullbrenneren. Gjenskap den gamle bonderomantiske stemningen med historiske klær og en fredelig skogbakgrunn.
englishMainImagePrompt: In an old Norwegian forest from the 15th to 19th century, depict the rooster hurrying to the spring with each character in their period dress: the Linden Tree adorned with red gold ribbons, the kind Virgin Mary offering help, the shoemaker in his humble workshop, and the sow waiting nearby. Show a gentle, pastoral scene where the forest light filters through the trees, capturing the folktale’s timeless spirit.
